pcs.pc_description: verify the cracked coconuts are free from any dirt and are ready for the next process
peel the brown portion of the coconut known as testa, using scrapping technique
wash the kernels with clean water to remove any dirt
cut the kernel to remove the coconut water
transfer the coconut into blanching tank with boiling water (for Blanching) for 8-10 minutes and put them into the cold water to cool down
use coconut grater or shredder to get the coconut flakes of different sizes
dry the different grades coconut flakes in a tunnel or belt dryer for 45 minutes at 80–90- degree centigrade temperature to remove the moisture content
pass the coconut flakes to the Sievers or sifters to grade them based on their size
use a hammer mill or disk mill grind the desiccated coconut to get another value added product the coconut powder
move the finished products (graded desiccated coconut, coconut powder) to the packaging area
clean and sanitize the equipment used in the process as per the cleaning guidelines
verify the cracked coconuts are free from any dirt and are ready for the next process
peel the brown portion of the coconut known as testa, using scrapping technique
wash the kernels with clean water to remove any dirt
cut the kernel to remove the coconut water
transfer the coconut into blanching tank with boiling water (for Blanching) for 8-10 minutes and put them into the cold water to cool down
use coconut grater or shredder to cut them into smaller sizes
transfer the cut coconut to hydraulic pressure extractors to press them to extract milk
remove any residual coconut fibres from the milk using a sieve or filter
transfer it to filter presses or membrane filters to get more refined coconut milk
pasteurize the milk at 72-75 degrees temperature using pasteurizing machine to destroy harmful bacteria for 20 minutes
transfer the milk to the cooling system and allow it to cool
transfer the cooled milk to the mechanical homogenizer or emulsification system to break the fat particles into smaller particles
check the quality of the milk for color, viscosity, flavor and microbiological safety
move the produce to the designated area for packaging

modules.module_title: Extract coconut oil – Cold press method

pcs.pc_description: place the grated coconut meat into an industrial grade milk extractor (which applies centrifugal force) to separate milk from the coconut meat
transfer the filtered milk to a big container and allow it to ferment (this process creates a top layer of coconut cream, middle layer coconut oil and bottom layer of water)
skim off the middle layer of oil with the help of automated skimming equipment
allow it to settle for 72 hrs so that the water gets evaporated
collect the filtered oil in large containers
filter the resulting oil to remove any further solid remains
move the produce to the designated area for packaging

modules.module_title: Extract coconut oil – Hot processing method

pcs.pc_description: pick the clean, dry, good quality copra for oil extraction
use pulverisers to crush to coconut meat or copra to smaller particles
reduce the moisture content by heating the particles of copra using a dryer or direct flame
load the dried coconut into the expeller machine to crush them to extract oil
collect the oil in the barrel of the machine and expel the other solid wastes
use the filtration system to remove any impurities in the extracted oil
move it to the designated area for packaging

pcs.pc_description: harvest the fresh green coconuts from the tree and transfer it to processing plant
Check the coconuts for visible damage or contaminants
Clean and sterilize the coconut to remove any dirt or germs
Verify the extraction equipment are available and are working
Clean the equipment using approved cleaning agents
use a de-husking machine to remove the outer layer
transfer the de-husked coconuts to the processing area for coconut water extraction
use coconut drills to make a hole in the coconut
place the trimmed end of the coconut facing down ward in the conveyor system
driller/cutter makes a whole in each of the coconut for the water to flow
coconut water flows into the collection channels or containers
use a filter/sieve to remove small particles, pulp or other impurities
pasteurize the filtered coconut water and allow it to cool at 8-10° degree Celsius
collect the pasteurized coconut water in the aseptic tank
use direct ultra-high temperature sterilization at 140-144° C for four second
add preservatives or natural flavoring if needed
send samples for testing the attributes of the coconut water attributes: aroma, colour, flavour, texture etc
transport it to the designated area for packaging
clean the equipment using approved cleaning agents
clean the work area using industry approved the sanitizers
allow the equipment to dry and use towels to remove the moisture content
carry out regular maintenance of equipment and the other areas

pcs.pc_description: collect the coconut sap from the coconut palm
use a filter to remove impurities and dirt
use a vacuum pan to boil the sap at a low temperature till it reaches a thick, syrup consistency
use evaporator to remove excess water to increase concentration of sugar
stir it well till it reaches a desired consistency
transfer the hot syrup to clarifier to remove any impurities or solid particles (clarification process)
pour the clarified syrup back to the vacuum pan for further boiling and evaporation
use a drop test to check the consistency of the jaggery
use the color and taste test to check the sweetness level of the mixture
transfer the syrup to mould after its boiled till a desired consistency to cool and solidify
transport the finished product to the designated area for packaging
clean and sanitize the equipment used in the process as per the cleaning guidelines
